content.text: I will run the init script (if present), switch to ~/test, compute the counts as specified, multiply them, and print the final result.

arguments: {"script":"bash ~/init 2>/dev/null || true; cd ~/test || exit 1; count1=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -not -name \".*\" | wc -l); count2=$(find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -name \"*.txt\" -not -name \".*\" -size +0c | wc -l); echo $((count1 * count2))"}
